Alger, 20 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, October 20, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The operator Djezzy and the startup BortoCall have commercially launched Relay, a professional and collaborative instant messaging service. This encrypted solution is aimed at businesses, government agencies, and national institutions.
Déploiement d'une plateforme souveraine: Deployment of a sovereign platform in SaaS mode
Développée par la jeune pousse algérienn: Developed by the young Algerian startup BortoCall, the Relay application is distributed as Software-as-a-Service (SaaS). The tool is featured directly on the Djezzy Marketplace with plans tailored to each organization.
Le dispositif intègre des canaux de disc: The system includes internal discussion channels, individual or group messaging, as well as audio and video calls. Users can also share documents and interconnect multiple organizations. In addition, administrators have a centralized console to manage permissions, licenses, and access.
L'intégralité des données est stockée et: All data is stored and processed locally on the Djezzy Cloud infrastructure. This setup guarantees digital sovereignty and complies with personal data protection standards.
« Les entreprises et institutions doiven: "Businesses and institutions must be able to communicate in an environment where the confidentiality of their exchanges and control over their data are fully ensured," said Bilal Sefsaf, CEO and co-founder of BortoCall.
De son côté, le directeur général de Dje: Meanwhile, Djezzy CEO Boumediene Senouci highlighted a new milestone in supporting national companies with the transformation of their professional communications.
